verdict.rationale: Docs mention near-instant settlement ("move money near-instantly, 24/7") and real-time FX quotes/settlement in CPN, plus fee-free Circle Mint conversion, giving a thin signal on timing, but there is no published fee schedule broken out per rail and no mention of statements, ledgers, or accounting-consumable reports. missing for 10: explicit per-rail fee tables, formal settlement-timing SLAs (e.g., T+0 vs T+1 by rail), downloadable statements/reports for accounting reconciliation.
